177:t_1:654.en:
$$アルト$$
「Don't go, $$ランカ$$! You can't go!」

178:t_000:0.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「The $$翠の地球$$ group has arrived.」

178:t_001:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「Confirmed. The $$ネェル・アーガマ$$, the $$ラー・カイラム$$, and the $$プトレマイオス２$$ are there too.」

178:t_001:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So they made it through safely as well.」

178:t_001:2.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「With this much force gathered...」

178:t_001:3.en:
$$テッサ$$
「It should not be impossible to strike the Empire's capital, $$ラース・バビロン$$.」

178:t_001:4.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Once we've joined up with the $$クォーター$$ and the $$ダナン$$, we'll go straight into an operations meeting.」

182:t_1:3.en: ～ $$マクロス・クォーター$$ Hangar ～

182:t_1:4.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Major $$オズマ$$... Where was the place $$ミカゲ$$ was talking about?」

182:t_1:5.en:
$$オズマ$$
「A town in the northern Eurasian continent... It once had a prison run by the $$地球連邦$$, and the whole town existed to serve it.」

182:t_1:6.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Commonly known as $$ネオ・アルカトラズ$$... Now the Empire has built a $$ターミナル・ベース$$ there.」

182:t_1:8.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「So $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$ are being held by the $$新地球皇国$$, right?」

182:t_1:10.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Major $$カリーニン$$ has gone on ahead to survey the site.」

182:t_1:11.en:
$$宗介$$
「The Major used to be a soldier of the $$人革連$$. He should be the ideal person for a mission in that area.」

182:t_1:13.en:
$n
「It looks like the nightmare $$アルト$$ kept seeing was being shown to him by that $$ミカゲ$$.」

182:t_1:15.en:
$$甲児$$
「It has to be to provoke $$アルト$$ into rescuing $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$.」

182:t_1:16.en:
$$甲児$$
「And after that, he'll probably use the two of them for his own purposes all over again.」

182:t_1:17.en:
$$さやか$$
「But with that $$ミカゲ$$'s power, he could probably get the two of them out himself, even if the enemy is the $$サイデリアル$$.」

182:t_1:18.en:
$n
「Is security at $$ネオ・アルカトラズ$$ so tight that even he would have trouble...」

182:t_1:21.en:
$$アルト$$
「Captain... I request permission for a detached squad to move out.」

182:t_1:22.en:
$$アルト$$
「Me, $$宗介$$, $n, and then $$ヒイロ$$, $$スザク$$ and the others...」

182:t_1:25.en:
$$オズマ$$
「We've had our eye on $$ネオ・アルカトラズ$$ for some time as one of the facilities holding people abducted from all over.」

182:t_1:26.en:
$$オズマ$$
「This is a good chance. We'll take that place down and use it as a bridgehead for the assault on $$ラース・バビロン$$.」

182:t_1:28.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Don't underestimate me, $$アルト$$. I want to save $$ランカ$$ every bit as much as you do.」

182:t_1:29.en:
$$キャシー$$
「$$オズマ$$ went through the proper channels with the captains, as part of the overall strategy.」

182:t_1:30.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「That's our Captain for you.」

182:t_1:31.en:
$$木下$$
「Thank you, Big Brother! We shall surely rescue $$ランカ$$ and $$シェリル$$!」

182:t_1:32.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Who are you calling Big Brother?!」

182:t_1:33.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Now that it's settled, let's do this! We have to make it a success!」

182:t_1:34.en:
$$甲児$$
「Yeah, and not just $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$. We're rescuing everyone who's being held there!」

182:t_1:35.en:
$$宗介$$
「There is a chance the VIPs who were in $$オーブ$$ have been taken in there as well.」

182:t_1:36.en:
$n
「So if we take that place, we might learn what strategic goal the $$サイデリアル$$ are pursuing by abducting people.」

182:t_1:37.en:
$$アンディ$$
「We've got a big operation on our hands right after we've joined up.」

182:t_1:38.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Maybe Supreme Commander $$不動$$ sent us to $c because he saw this coming.」

182:t_1:40.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I know. We have to rescue the two of them no matter what, if only to stop $$ミカゲ$$ from getting his way any longer.」

182:t_1:41.en:
$$アルト$$
(Hold on, $$シェリル$$, $$ランカ$$... I'll definitely save you...)

182:t_1:45.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「No, it's nothing. Let's do our best too, $$ユノハ$$.」

182:t_1:46.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「We're infiltrating an enemy base, so $$ユノハ$$'s invisibility power is sure to come in handy.」

182:t_1:47.en:
$$ユノハ$$
「Yes...! When that time comes, I'll give it everything I've got, too.」

182:t_1:49.en:
$$モロイ$$
「Is it the power of love with $$ジン$$, maybe?」

182:t_1:50.en:
$$ユノハ$$
「W-when you put it like that... it's a little embarrassing...」

182:t_1:51.en:
$$モロイ$$
「You haven't changed in that respect.」

182:t_1:52.en:
$$スズネ$$
(The power of love... $$ミカゲ$$ said love and hatred are two sides of the same coin...)

182:t_1:53.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
(But I can't imagine him trying the method that failed him once all over again...)

182:t_1:54.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
(I don't get it... What is he plotting with $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$...?)

182:t_1:58.en: ～ Inside the Imperial Capital $$ラース・バビロン$$ ～

182:t_1:59.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「...I hear the $$堕天翅$$ in question has appeared.」

182:t_1:60.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「To be precise, it's a being born from the hatred of the $$堕天翅$$. At least it's no threat to me.」

182:t_1:61.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「Emotions becoming power... That's a sense I can't grasp.」

182:t_1:62.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「If you don't understand, then don't butt in. That's what makes that void of yours stand out, isn't it?」

182:t_1:64.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「Understood, $$ストラウス$$. I have no intention of starting pointless trouble.」

182:t_1:65.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Where are you going, $$尸空#pilot$$? Planning to run away?」

182:t_1:66.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「I'm going up into space... No problem, $$ストラウス$$?」

182:t_1:69.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「If I don't understand it, I'll just find out for myself. I'm mobilizing $$鬼宿$$.」

182:t_1:70.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Hmph... Let's see what you can do, $$ムリエル・ザ・ゲート$$...」

182:t_10:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Magnificent, Miss $$ユノハ$$. I had the pleasure of savoring the new $$アクエリオン$$'s finishing move.」

182:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh, you're already gone! And completely invisible, at that!」
